tunables.label: Gateway Token
tunables.description: Bearer token that gateway clients must present; required in production when the gateway binds beyond loopback.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set a stable token (or OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD) so clients survive restarts; a non-loopback bind with no auth path fails closed. The example is a local-only dummy value for compose validation.

tunables.label: Gateway Bind Mode
tunables.description: Where the gateway listens: `lan` or `0.0.0.0` accept published container traffic, `loopback` stays local.
tunables.troubleshooting: With `loopback` the published 18789 port is unreachable from the host — use `lan` (container default) or 0.0.0.0.

tunables.label: Gateway Port
tunables.description: HTTP port the gateway listens on; must match the published container port.
tunables.troubleshooting: If the healthcheck times out, confirm the published mapping matches this value (18789:18789).

tunables.label: Node Environment
tunables.description: Node.js execution mode; the image already defaults to production.
tunables.troubleshooting: Leave at production — development mode enables verbose error pages and slower builds.

notes: The gateway starts from the image default command (`node openclaw.mjs gateway`); probes are GET /healthz (liveness) and GET /startupz (readiness), both unauthenticated on the gateway port. Gateway settings otherwise live in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json on the mounted volume; provider and channel credentials are external requirements and intentionally absent.
